title: Venus quit checking on her exes.
caption: Venus spent the retrograde checking the rearview mirror for every ex. Now she's back as the Morning Star, up early and lighter. Looking back is part of healing. Growth is facing the sunrise. Send this to the friend who finally stopped checking.
